resources.string: Start by selecting this option on a trusted device
When prompted to do so, select this option on the evaluated device
On the device you wish to evaluate, go to\n Settings/DeviceDiagnostics/Evaluated Device\n Follow the prompts on that device.

You will now be shown a series of screens. Study each on and look for defects. Once you are satisfied, touch the screen to move to the next one. At the end, you will be asked if the screens look unblemished.
Please select the option below that best matches the condition of the screen.

You will now be shown a white screen. Rub your finger over the screen until the screen is entirely red. Be careful not to short tap the screen. If you are unable to turn part of the screen red, short tap the screen to indicate that the touch sensor is not fully working.
The touch sensor will be reported as good if you touch the whole screen, defective if you short tap it.
Please scan this QR code on the trusted device. After you have scanned it, you may press Done on this device.
